subject.title: [Feature]: Include interaction metadata in Discord button callbacks

question: Should generic Discord component clicks expose a new agent-visible structured interaction metadata envelope, and which fields should be public versus plugin-only?
rationale: This changes the public agent inbound context and exposes Discord identifiers plus callback data, so maintainers need to choose the schema, trust boundary, and compatibility shape before implementation.

options.title: Add Typed Agent Metadata
options.body: Expose a narrow documented envelope with original message id, action kind, safe callback/custom data, label/value details, and clicker identity, backed by Discord plugin tests.

options.title: Keep Metadata Plugin-Only
options.body: Leave rich interaction fields available only to plugin interactive handlers and document that stateful Discord workflows should use plugin callbacks rather than generic agent fallback messages.

options.title: Start With Message And Component IDs
options.body: Expose only the originating message id and component id first, deferring callback payload semantics until a broader inbound metadata contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Add Typed Agent Metadata
recommendation.body: Expose a narrow documented envelope with original message id, action kind, safe callback/custom data, label/value details, and clicker identity, backed by Discord plugin tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Current active Discord component dispatch and plugin-interactive code history most directly points to this owner for the public inbound-context boundary.
